'''Bonda''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who worked for [[Oridelve Incorporated]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gavos]]. During the [[Gavos Droid Revolution]], he was trapped with [[Marv Moray]] and the other [[Miner/Legends|miners]]. He was rescued by a group of adventurers working for [[Bargos (Hutt)|Bargos]].
